origin_prefix_policy.meaning: Original reviewer host home directory; bind to local home to recover original absolute paths.
origin_prefix_policy.scope: Only literal home-prefix substitution; toolchain versions, source/model/artifact hashes, suffix paths and reported observations preserved.

hash_rules: original_sha256 hashes the immutable file before publication (including gzip wrapper when present).
published_sha256 hashes this capsule file; original/release hashes remain unchanged inside audit copies.
Home substitution changes some audit-copy bytes; do not feed those copies into the v5 frozen hash validator.
SHA256SUMS at capsule root validates published files, including this provenance. Nested historical sums describe originals only.
